sharedSource.sourceFinding: The pinned Hungarian Wikipedia revision identifies the Zalabér-Batyk–Zalaszentgrót railway as line 24 and explicitly lists Zalaszentgrót in its route diagram. Its cited history sources include Magyar Vasúttörténet volume 2, a Hungaricana archival map, a government news source and independent railway press; no VPE/HÜSZ/KTI/GYSEV source lineage was found during the detailed line-level review.
sharedSource.caveat: The route diagram explicitly associates Zalaszentgrót with line 24, but the individual route-diagram row does not carry its own inline citation. The article is marked as having relatively few sources; this limitation is disclosed for the human reviewer and is not an automatic blocker under the current approved review policy.
